item.title: 3rd quake jolts Dhaka, other parts in 40 hours
item.description: An earthquake shook Dhaka and several other parts of the country on Friday afternoon. It was third tremor that hit Bangladesh within a span of 40 hours.According to Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD), the earthquake measuring 5.4 on the Richter scale was felt at 1:52 pm.The epicentre was located in Assasuni upazila of Satkhira District, said BMD Meteorologist Shahnaj Sultana.According to the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC), the epicentre was located 47 kilometres south

item.title: Pricey fruits frown at fixed-income groups
item.description: Ramadan's fruit fest has turned forbidding for fixed-income families. From wholesale hubs to neighborhood stalls, prices of both imported and local fruits have climbed steeply, leaving buyers counting coins instead of calories.Traders and shoppers alike say imported apples, oranges, grapes, pomegranates, plums and pears now cost Tk 50 to Tk 100 more per kilogram than before Ramadan. item.title: Grandmother killed, granddaughter raped in Pabna; bodies recovered from separate places
item.description: A grandmother has been killed and her teenage granddaughter has been raped and murdered after being abducted in Pabna's Ishwardi upazila.The incident happened any time on Friday night. on Friday night.Police recovered the two bodies from separate locations in Bhabanipur Uttarpara village under Dashuria Union on Saturday morning.The deceased were identified as Sufia Khatun, 65, mother of Joynal Kha of the area, and her granddaughter Jamila Akter, 15.
